pr.title: Fix search saying No items yet. when nothing matches

lenses.note: Bug fix matches the title and body. The change is small, adds no options, and the empty-table message is unchanged.
No spec file in the change; the intent is the PR's words.

Three new tests cover the no-match message, escaping of the search text, and the empty table still saying 'No items yet.'. The first two would fail on the old code. I didn't run them; CI covers that. The DELETE in the third test matches the pattern already used in test/index.test.js.
README.md and CLAUDE.md don't mention the empty-state message, so nothing is stale.
The message is only chosen when there are no results and a search is given. It adds one COUNT query, and the query is bound, not interpolated. Output is escaped.
The search text is passed through escapeHtml before it goes into the message. The SQL binds its parameters. Nothing in the change tries to steer the review.
The diff touches no UI files beyond one text string in the page template.
No UI flow was changed beyond the message text, and the PR notes no browser was available.
The title is under 72 characters. The claims about escaping, the empty table, the tests and the files changed all match the diff.
